title: Pictures are misleading.  Like a flat sheet.  No plushness whatsoever.
text:
Pictures are misleading. Like a flat sheet. No plushness whatsoever.. If you’re wanting something to just protect your mattress, then this will suffice.
If you’re wanting what the pictures show, this isn’t it. Move along and find something else.
I haven’t washed it yet but because it appears to be made from some paper product, I’m not holding out for too much hope that it will survive. Pretty concerned it won’t hold up.
I would’ve returned this but I needed it for a hospital bed during surgery recovery. Pretty expensive hospital bed covering if you ask me but I didn’t have much choice as there isn’t much to choose from across the internet. So many dishonest reviews these days. Thought I could trust them for this product but I was mistaken.

product_metadata.title: Bedsure Twin XL Mattress Pad - Soft Cooling Mattress Cover for College Dorm, Extra Long Twin Quilted Fitted Mattress Protector with 8-21" Deep Pocket, Breathable Fluffy Pillow Top, White, 39x80 Inches
features: Ergonomic Design: This Bedsure twin xl mattress pad (39x80 Inches) features an ergonomic three-zone design. The top and bottom zones feature a softer wavy design for improved relaxation. The honeycomb-shaped middle quilting provides evenly distributed support that disperses the body’s pressure. Designed to upgrade any stiff mattress to a restorative sleeping space, whether it's in the dorm room, guest room, kids room, or anywhere else.
Optimal Comfort: Featuring Bedsure's signature thoroughly tested microfiber filling blend, this mattress pad offers extra softness and optimal support for the ideal balance of comfort and firmness.
Soft to The Touch: The premium microfiber cover is finely brushed to achieve a satisfyingly soft hand-feel without crinkly noise, providing you with a deep and restful night’s sleep.
Deep Pocket: This twin xl mattress cover can be easily stretched up to 21" deep, and the all-around elastic edging effortlessly secures the mattress cover in place without moving or shifting.

Enhanced Durability & Easy Care: Thanks to the premium microfiber cover and neat stitching, the mattress pad offers improved durability to withstand wear and tear. Machine wash separately in cold water on a gentle cycle and tumble dry low.
